proposed.text: For a government-funded architectural project, what audit-safe documentation posture should the architect maintain?

options.text: Keep only cost estimates because COA review is purely financial
Keep traceable procurement, payment, change, approval, and technical records that support legality, propriety, economy, and accountability
Keep no design records once the Building Official approves the permit
Keep only meeting minutes because RA 9266 replaces audit rules

proposed.rationale: Government-funded projects need records that support legality, propriety, economy, accountability, and traceability. Do not overstate COA as a design-review board.
proposed.explanation: RA 9184 supplies transparency/accountability policy for procurement; RA 7160 accounting and audit provisions support legality/propriety and COA access where LGU funds are involved.
proposed.code_citation: RA 9184 procurement policy; RA 7160 local accounting, disbursement, and COA access provisions
